x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Validate, render, and deploy DubUrl schema documents.

commands.name: capabilities
commands.description: Report supported schema and deployment capabilities.

commands.name: connector
commands.description: Manage client-side connector packs. Connectors are integrations, not database servers.

commands.name: install
commands.description: Download, verify, install, and activate a curated connector pack for this user.

options.name: --archive
options.description: Install this local ZIP against the approved catalog without network access or fallback.

arguments.name: CONNECTOR
arguments.description: Canonical connector ID or alias (for example postgresql).

commands.name: list
commands.description: List curated and installed connectors with activation and health status.

commands.name: mirror
commands.description: Prepare verified archives and a catalog for internal hosting or offline transfer.

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description: New directory for the unpublished mirror snapshot.

arguments.name: ARCHIVE_BASE_URL
arguments.description: Internal HTTPS URL where the archives will be hosted.

commands.name: uninstall
commands.description: Atomically deactivate and remove a user-scoped connector pack.

arguments.name: CONNECTOR
arguments.description: Installed connector ID or catalog alias.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Inspect databases or validate, render, and deploy a versioned schema document.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Validate, render, and execute a schema through the application service.

options.name: --input-format
options.description: Input format for standard input or an extensionless file: yaml or json.

options.name: --connection-env
options.description: Name of an environment variable containing the connection URL.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the exact SQL without opening a connection.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Confirm destructive deployment in non-interactive use.

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Schema document path, or '-' for standard input.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Read database metadata and export a versioned schema document. Does not change the database.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Named connection from configuration. Exactly one connection selector is required.

options.name: --connection-env
options.description: Environment variable containing a URL. Exclusive with --connection.

options.name: --table
options.description: Qualified table name; repeat to select several. Omit to inspect all visible tables.

options.name: --schema
options.description: Schema name; repeat to select several schemas.

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the document to a file. Omit for standard output.

options.name: --output-format
options.description: yaml or json. Overrides the output filename extension; defaults to YAML on stdout. Unknown extensions require this option.

options.name: --allow-partial
options.description: Deliberately export incomplete metadata with diagnostics on standard error. Strict export is the default.

options.name: --include-references
options.description: Include the transitive foreign-key target tables outside the filters.

options.name: --basic
options.description: Request tables, columns, primary keys, and foreign keys only.

commands.name: render
commands.description: Validate and render deterministic dialect-specific SQL.

options.name: --input-format
options.description: Input format for standard input or an extensionless file: yaml or json.

options.name: --dialect
options.description: SQL dialect (for example pgsql, mssql, or sqlite).

options.name: --output
options.description: Write SQL to this file instead of standard output.

options.name: --drop-existing
options.description: Render explicit drop-if-exists statements before creation.

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Schema document path, or '-' for standard input.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate a schema document without opening a database connection.

options.name: --input-format
options.description: Input format for standard input or an extensionless file: yaml or json.

arguments.name: INPUT
arguments.description: Schema document path, or '-' for standard input.
